title: Graphophone, radio and early phones at home
summary: Julius recalls the family phone number, the wind-up Graphophone and when radios and TVs arrived.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Those days you didn't have any numbers. No, you didn't. Three numbers. One eight four. That was it. And, uh, we had one of those great big old, uh, we used to call them Graftophones. We had one of those great...
The one that you wind up to play the record?

And my daddy used to burn us out Chinese. Burn us out Chinese though. I used to get a kick out of that. And at that time, like, you had a piano. And there was a really big old Graftophones. And, like, Caps and I, we were, uh, playing music, you know?
